cv.name: Pham Bui Nam Phuong

cv.summary: A highly adaptable Web Developer with hands-on expertise in FastAPI, ReactJS, and CI/CD pipelines. Backed by a strong academic foundation in Telecommunications and Distributed Systems, I specialize in engineering secure API integrations, architecting Identity Management solutions, and optimizing deployment engines to support high-performance enterprise applications.
cv.objective: Dedicated Software Engineer seeking to leverage hands-on expertise in high-concurrency API engineering, federated IAM middleware, and robust CI/CD automation to drive system reliability and deliver high-impact product features.

experiences.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

bullets.text: **Altus Entertainment** - A large-scale CRM and CMS ecosystem managing over 20,000 artists in the US.

Engineered an **automated content generation pipeline** integrating FastAPI, ReactJS, and LLMs, eliminating manual data entry delays and **accelerating the article drafting process by 80%** (from 5 hours to under 1 hour).

Optimized complex **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)** trees to resolve a critical **performance bottleneck**, **reducing login latency by 91%** (from 60 seconds to 5 seconds) for over 3,000 permission nodes.
Architected a **fault-tolerant message broker system** using RabbitMQ with strict retry mechanisms, successfully **resolving severe cross-service data discrepancies by 80%** without data loss.

experiences.location: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam

bullets.text: **NEEC Platform** - Custom CMS development and infrastructure optimization for an international consulting agency.

Configured and maintained automated CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, achieving near **zero-downtime deployments** and **restricting server release windows to just 2 minutes** during off-peak traffic.
Spearheaded the **migration of a legacy platform** to a modern Vue 3 and Node.js stack, significantly **improving system scalability and SEO indexing**.
Designed custom semantic search mappings and data normalization workflows to streamline client query processing across the internal database.
Architected a scalable microservices platform within a strict **2-month MVP timeline**, managing end-to-end system design, RESTful API integrations, and Docker containerization.
Integrated Keycloak as the central **Identity and Access Management (IAM) middleware**, ensuring **secure user segregation and robust API protection**.
Maximized **delivery routing efficiency** by customizing Dijkstra's algorithm with turn-cost calculations for urban terrains.

coverLetter.openingParagraph: I am writing to express my strong interest in the **Web Developer** position at Endava to support the CI engine for your **Radio 55G system**. As a software engineer with hands-on experience in **ReactJS**, **FastAPI**, and CI/CD operations, coupled with a deep academic background in **Digital Signal Processing** and **Distributed Systems** from the Posts and Telecommunications Institute of Technology (PTIT), I am highly motivated to bring my technical rigor and domain-relevant mindset to your world-class engineering team.
bodyParagraphs: Your requirement for an adaptable developer to improve web tools seamlessly aligns with my recent achievements. At PRIMAS CO. LTD, I engineered an automated pipeline utilizing **FastAPI** and **ReactJS** that accelerated content generation by **80%**. Furthermore, during my graduation project, I architected a microservices-based logistics engine where I independently integrated **<u>Keycloak</u>** as the core Identity and Access Management (IAM) middleware. This experience ensures I am fully prepared to handle the authentication and secure service integration demands of your ecosystem.

Beyond coding, I have a deep appreciation for the operational reliability of CI tools. At Algorit Lab, I configured robust **GitHub Actions** pipelines that achieved near **zero-downtime** deployments. While I am currently transitioning my containerization expertise from **Docker** to **<u>Kubernetes (K8s)</u>**, my solid understanding of Cloud Native principles and my academic foundation in Telecommunications enable me to grasp the complexities of Radio 5G CI engines rapidly. I thrive in Agile environments where taking architectural ownership and continuous troubleshooting are the norms.
coverLetter.closingParagraph: I am eager to contribute my problem-solving skills and passion for high-performance web development to Endava's cross-functional teams. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my hands-on technical stack and telecommunication background can directly benefit your CI engine infrastructure. Thank you for your time and consideration.
